post.summary: Returns the application by OAuth client ID
Returns a list of installed applications

post.description:
Replaces all existing access codes for the application with the provided ones.
		For personal applications, the owner user access code is always added to the saved access codes.
		Access codes define which users or groups can use the application.
		Administrators and personal application owners always have access regardless of access codes.
		For shared applications, if no access codes are set, the application is available to everyone.
		For personal applications, if no access codes are set, only the owner and administrators have access.
		Request example:
		{
			"clientId": "local.69b9196bdbd793.03286491",
			"codes": ["UA", "D1"]
		}

Removes specified access codes from the application.
		Only the provided codes are removed; other existing codes remain unchanged.
		Administrators and personal application owners always have access regardless of access codes.
		Request example:
		{
			"clientId": "local.69b9196bdbd793.03286491",
			"codes": ["D1"]
		}

post.summary: Resets the application access to default values
post.description:
Removes all custom access codes and restores the default access settings for the application.
		For personal applications, the default is the owner and administrators only.
		For shared applications, the default is no restrictions (available to everyone).
		Request example:
		{
			"clientId": "local.69b9196bdbd793.03286491"
		}

Returns the current access codes assigned to the application,
		including detailed information about each code (provider and display name).
		Administrators and personal application owners always have access regardless of access codes.
		For shared applications, if no access codes are set, the application is available to everyone.
		For personal applications, if no access codes are set, only the owner and administrators have access.
		Request example:
		{
			"clientId": "local.69b9196bdbd793.03286491"
		}

callType.title: callType
callType.description: Call type: 1 = instant ad-hoc, 2 = permanent conference room, 3 = large room.

initiatorId.title: initiatorId
initiatorId.description: User id of who initiated the call.

startDate.title: startDate
startDate.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the call started.

endDate.title: endDate
endDate.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the call ended. Null while the call is still in progress.

durationSeconds.title: durationSeconds
durationSeconds.description: Total call duration in seconds (endDate − startDate).

uuid.title: uuid
uuid.description: Opaque UUID of the call session. Opt-in: list this in `select` to receive it.

language.title: language
language.description: Detected transcription language (BCP-47 / ISO 639-1, e.g. "ru", "en"). Null when there is no transcription.

version.title: version
version.description: Maximum schema version across all stored outcome blocks (transcription, overview, summary, insights, evaluation).

participants.title: participants
participants.description: Call participants, enriched with display data from Util::getUsers (name, avatar, work position). Opt-in via `select`.

outcomes.title: outcomes
outcomes.description: Names of outcome blocks present for this call: any subset of [transcription, overview, summary, insights, evaluation].

createdAt.title: createdAt
createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recently stored outcome record for this call.

tracks.title: tracks
tracks.description: Call recordings / tracks with download URLs. Opt-in via `select`.

transcription.title: transcription
transcription.description: Time-ordered transcription of the call with per-segment speaker attribution.

overview.title: overview
overview.description: AI overview of the meeting: topic, agenda, agreements, action items, takeaways.

summary.title: summary
summary.description: Segmented summary of the call by topic chunks.

insights.title: insights
insights.description: AI insights: per-speaker analysis (CIS only), meeting strengths/weaknesses, recommendations.

evaluation.title: evaluation
evaluation.description: Meeting efficiency evaluation: overall score and individual evaluation criteria.

language.title: language
language.description: Detected transcription language as BCP-47 / ISO 639-1 code (e.g. "ru", "en"). Null when the language could not be determined.

segments.title: segments
segments.description: Time-ordered transcription segments. Each segment is one continuous utterance by a single speaker.

topic.title: topic
topic.description: AI-detected meeting topic in one short phrase.

detailedTakeaways.title: detailedTakeaways
detailedTakeaways.description: Long-form summary of meeting outcomes (multiple sentences). @-mentions are rendered in the selected mentionFormat.

meetingType.title: meetingType
meetingType.description: Meeting type. Shape: { explanation: string, typeTag: string (raw AI tag, e.g. "planning"), title: string (localized) }.

agenda.title: agenda
agenda.description: Agenda detection. Shape: { explanation: string (was an agenda announced and how it was set), quote: string (verbatim agenda quote from transcription) }.

agreements.title: agreements
agreements.description: List of explicit agreements. Each item: { agreement: string (AI-rephrased agreement, may contain @-mentions in selected mentionFormat), quote?: string (supporting transcription excerpt) }.

actionItems.title: actionItems
actionItems.description: Action items. Each item: { actionItem: string (with @-mentions), actionItemMentionLess?: string (same text without markup), quote?: string }.

meetings.title: meetings
meetings.description: Planned follow-up meetings. Each item: { meeting: string (with @-mentions), meetingMentionLess?: string, quote?: string }.

segments.title: segments
segments.description: Time-ordered segments of the meeting summary. Each segment covers a continuous topical chunk of the call.

speakerEvaluationAvailable.title: speakerEvaluationAvailable
speakerEvaluationAvailable.description: Whether per-speaker evaluation is available on this portal. False for non-CIS regions; speakerAnalysis is empty in that case.

speakerAnalysis.title: speakerAnalysis
speakerAnalysis.description: Per-speaker analysis, sorted by talkPercentage DESC, efficiencyValue DESC. Each item: { userId, detailedInsight, efficiencyValue (0..100), evaluationCriteria (map of criterion->{value,criteria,title}), talkPercentage, duration (seconds), durationFormat (localized human label) }.

meetingStrengths.title: meetingStrengths
meetingStrengths.description: Meeting strengths. Each item: { strengthTitle: string (short label), strengthExplanation: string (detailed reasoning) }.

meetingWeaknesses.title: meetingWeaknesses
meetingWeaknesses.description: Meeting weaknesses. Each item: { weaknessTitle: string, weaknessExplanation: string }.

speechStyleInfluence.title: speechStyleInfluence
speechStyleInfluence.description: AI commentary on how speakers' communication style affected the meeting outcome.

engagementLevel.title: engagementLevel
engagementLevel.description: Free-form AI assessment of overall meeting engagement.

areasOfResponsibility.title: areasOfResponsibility
areasOfResponsibility.description: AI-detected delegated areas of responsibility and ownership coming out of the meeting.

finalRecommendations.title: finalRecommendations
finalRecommendations.description: Final AI recommendations for future meetings of this team or topic.

efficiencyValue.title: efficiencyValue
efficiencyValue.description: Overall meeting efficiency score in the range 0..100. Computed as the share of passed criteria, including the calendar overhead penalty.

calendar.title: calendar
calendar.description: Calendar booking quality. Shape: { overhead: bool } — whether the meeting ran past its scheduled end time.

criteria.title: criteria
criteria.description: Meeting evaluation criteria map. Keys are AI-driven criterion codes (e.g. agenda_clearly_stated). Each value has shape { value: bool (passed/failed), criteria: string (raw code, mirrors the key), thoughts: string (AI commentary in selected mentionFormat), title: string (localized) }.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Event severity level (INFO, WARNING, ERROR, etc.)

moduleId.title: Module
moduleId.description: The module that produced the event.

itemId.title: Item ID
itemId.description: The ID of an item associated with the event.

remoteAddr.title: IP address
remoteAddr.description: The IP address of a user associated with the event.

userAgent.title: User Agent
userAgent.description: The User Agent string: the user's browser and OS.

requestUri.title: Request URL
requestUri.description: The URL that was used to initiate the request.

siteId.title: Site ID
siteId.description: The ID of a site associated with the event.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The ID of a user associated with the event.

guestId.title: Guest ID
guestId.description: The ID of a guest (i.e. a user who didn't log in).

applicationToken.title: Application token (shared secret used to authenticate webhook callbacks from the portal)

codesDetails.title: Access code details with provider and display name
